items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Desktop-app style menubar on Base UI Menubar: roving focus across triggers, hover switching while open, and the same rows as Menu (items, submenus, checkbox, radio, shortcuts).
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Compose Menubar > MenubarMenu > MenubarTrigger + MenubarContent with MenubarItem, MenubarSub, MenubarCheckboxItem and friends (aliases of the Menu parts).
